input.encoding: [n], the square matrix and vector dimension

output.meaning: sum of final w elements in ascending index order after the four source-ordered GEMVER passes

source_bound.description: PolyBench/C defaults to binary64. It sets alpha=1.5 and beta=1.2; initializes u1[i]=i, u2[i]=((i+1)/n)/2, v1[i]=((i+1)/n)/4, v2[i]=((i+1)/n)/6, y[i]=((i+1)/n)/8, z[i]=((i+1)/n)/9, x=w=0, and A[i][j]=(i*j mod n)/n. The kernel first updates A[i][j] with u1[i]*v1[j]+u2[i]*v2[j], then updates x[i] from beta*A[j][i]*y[j] for j ascending, adds z[i] to x, and updates w[i] from alpha*A[i][j]*x[j] for j ascending. The suite reduces final w in ascending i order. The launcher selects EXTRALARGE_DATASET (N=20000); suite n is bounded to 1..64.
